name: TRADFRI LED driver, 10 w (ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2)
config_flow_discovery_remarks: Select this profile only if the printed driver type is ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2. The shared Home Assistant identifier may also match IL-1. Select the driver revision and connected load you actually have.
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks: Select only the YTBERG 1.5W load subprofile matching the actual number of connected lamps (1x, 2x, 3x or 4x, where available). Each subprofile estimates the complete ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2 driver plus the connected lamps. The measurements do not represent individual lamps and must not be multiplied or divided by the number of lamps. Other connected loads are not supported.
